snippet.title: Skydiving Extreme PS1 Gameplay [No Commentary]
snippet.description:
I have a ton of games in my backlog that I've either never played or played very little.  So I thought it might be fun to sample semi-random games and upload them so everyone can see how terrible I am at them!

So here we have a game called Skydiving Extreme for the PlayStation.  It was developed by Metro and published in North America by Natsume in 2001.  Well, what can I say...I'm HORRIBLE at this game!  It felt more like a rhythm game to me since you just follow the button presses on the screen.  I think this game has some potential if you could use the analog sticks, but I couldn't seem to get them to work (the back of the case does not indicate they're supported, but I kept trying haha).  I captured this video on a PlayStation.

You can check out my full video game collection here:  http://www.completionator.com/Collection/Index/1
